_comment: THE AI-MEDIA PROVENANCE REGISTER. Every file under the four AI-media roots is listed here with the generator that produced it and whether it still carries that generator's provenance markings. tests/build/aiMediaProvenance.test.js walks it: a file on disk that is not registered here FAILS, a registered file missing from disk FAILS, a 'present' file that loses a required marker FAILS, and the number of 'absent' rows is a SHRINK-ONLY ratchet. Adding AI media without recording its origin is therefore impossible, and metadata that survives today cannot be stripped tomorrow.
_why: Higgsfield Terms of Use section 5.5 ('you will not remove, alter, or obscure any provenance signals or markings') binds this pre-existing account from 2026-08-27; BytePlus's section 2(e) already prohibits the same act upstream. Two tracked sharp pipelines (scripts/optimize-backgrounds.mjs and scripts/optimize-landing-backgrounds.mjs) stripped metadata by default until 2026-08-24; both now call .keepMetadata() and the source-scan arm of the walker keeps it that way.

_markers.present: Carries provenance today. The 'require' list is pinned byte-for-byte by the walker.
_markers.absent: AI-generated, carries no provenance marking. Owed a restore (see _restorable). SHRINK-ONLY.
_markers.n/a: Origin unrecorded. Nothing to pin and nothing owed HERE — see _cohort_a.

_restorable.restorable: A human-readable credit: XMP photoshop:Credit, IPTC DigitalSourceType=trainedAlgorithmicMedia, the generator name and the generation date. This is a metadata write and needs no re-render.
_restorable.NOT restorable: The C2PA / Content Credentials manifests. They are cryptographically signed by Google LLC and by Byteplus Pte. Ltd., they cannot be re-created from nothing and MUST NOT be fabricated. AND RE-FETCHING THE ORIGINAL DOES NOT HELP: a C2PA manifest carries a hard binding over the asset's own bytes, so it validates only for the exact file it was issued for. Every shipped still is a resize or a re-encode of its master, so no shipped derivative can carry a VALID manifest however the manifest is obtained - re-attaching one would produce a manifest that fails validation, which is worse than none. A derivative can lawfully carry a NEW manifest naming the original as an ingredient, but minting one needs a C2PA signing identity the estate does not hold. A re-added credit is a CREDIT and must never be described as a restored C2PA.
_restorable.unknown: The SynthID pixel watermark in the Google-generated stills. It is designed to survive rescaling, so it may still be present in the shipped derivatives, but no detector was available to test it. A metadata write can neither restore nor damage it.

_cohort_a.what: 23 files, 7,413,151 bytes, listed below with origin 'unrecorded'. Introduced 2026-06-05 (with two later derivations), SIX WEEKS BEFORE the Higgsfield account's first transaction at 2026-07-18T17:15:55Z, so they are provably NOT Higgsfield output and NOTHING in the Higgsfield or BytePlus terms covers them.
_cohort_a.boundary: They are the estate's only unlicensed shipped imagery and they belong to the still-open reverse-image -search question, NOT to this register's remediation. Do not sweep them into an AI-provenance restore and do not let a disclosure notice assert an origin for them that nobody can state.
_cohort_a.hazard: git log --diff-filter=A LIES about cohort membership: the six *.orig.jpg files were CREATED by 5b582428c on 2026-07-18 but hold JUNE content, and six files first added by f1727ecfa on 2026-06-05 were OVERWRITTEN by 5b582428c and are now Higgsfield paintings. Derive membership from the LAST-touching commit.
_cohort_a.stale_derivatives: public/backgrounds/landing/city-1400.jpg and world-map-1400.jpg were built 2026-07-11 from the June paintings; their sources city.jpg and world-map.jpg were replaced by Higgsfield paintings on 2026-07-18 and never rebuilt. The next run of optimize:landing-backgrounds moves both rows from 'unrecorded' to 'higgsfield:google-image@2026-07-18'.

_not_shipped.marketing/website/public/bg.mp4: 76,303,695 bytes, the concatenation of the same six seedance_2_0 legs and the largest AI artifact the estate owns. UNTRACKED, in no deploy config (no vercel.json, no netlify.toml, no .vercel under marketing/website/), and therefore not shipping. It is outside this register only while that stays true: if any future deploy picks it up it inherits every obligation recorded here, and the disclosure work is free today and not free once a public marketing surface has launched undisclosed.

_indemnity_standing_risk: NOBODY INDEMNIFIES THE ESTATE. Higgsfield offers IP indemnification on the Enterprise plan only and the account was a paid consumer subscription; BytePlus's indemnity runs one way, toward BytePlus, and its section 7.5(c) voids protection where output was 'modified, transformed, or combined with products or services not provided by BytePlus' - which describes every file listed here. Not curable by any change in this repository; recorded so it is not re-found as a bug.

_originals.where: ~/Desktop/settlementforge-marketing-masters/ - out of repo, on the owner's own disk, no download and no vendor round-trip needed. Measured 2026-08-24 by raw byte scan over 82 media files: 32 carry a C2PA manifest, 25 carry the 'Made with Google AI' credit and a SynthID marker.
_originals.what it buys: The human-readable credit, in full and first-hand: the masters are the authoritative source for the XMP photoshop:Credit, the IPTC DigitalSourceType tag, the hf-job-id and the generation date that a restore would write into the shipped derivatives. No approval-gated download is required for that work.
_originals.what it does NOT buy: A valid C2PA on anything the site serves. See _restorable. The one shipped file that carries a valid manifest, public/videos/realm-journey.mp4, carries it precisely because it was never re-encoded, and that is the whole reason re-generating the media would be a net LOSS rather than a cure.
_originals.ten masters with no Google attribution: evolution-3-village, export-dispatch, gallery-board, hamlet-standalone-alt, metropolis-standalone-alt, 05-ledger-spread, 06-lexicon-page, 12-wax-press, 13-manuscript-page, 14-arrival carry an hf-job-id and no Google marker at all. Which model produced them is NOT established, so a restore must not stamp 'Made with Google AI' onto their derivatives. Two of the ten reach production.
